topic: Evaluating Tenant Quality and Lease Strength
caption:
Lesson 26 focuses on evaluating tenant quality and lease strength — a practical discipline for commercial investors, landlords, owners, and business operators in Chester County and Montgomery County. Evaluate tenant financials, guarantors, payment history, permitted use, and operational fit alongside lease mechanics: term, escalations, expense pass-throughs, and remedies. A rigorous lease review protects cash flow, supports financing, and reduces operational surprises. Locally, confirm zoning, insurance, and neighborhood use patterns before committing. Use checklists, obtain tenant financials and references, and negotiate clear assignment and default clauses. We help owners assess lease strength and tenant risk in practical, actionable terms.
